name: Karl Uler Pablo ex Papilio Lunae

skillCards.name: Gale Severance
skillCards.desc:
[Unique/Retain] 
Generates 4 [Air Current] every turn
For the turn this card is activated: 1 [Wind Barrier]
For Every Attack Card in Hand: 3 [Momentum]
skillCards.additional:
[Air Current] - Air-Based Attack Cards Gain +15% Damage Amount(max 10 stacks) 
[Wind Barrier] - Invincibility to 1 attack
[Momentum] - When Hitting with an Air-Based Attack Card, 50% Fixed Heal.
If Health is 50% or higher, +30% Damage Amount dealt by Air-Based Attack Cards, if 50% or lower, increase fixed heal by 25%.
When the effect is activated, decrease by 1 (max 30 stacks).

skillCards.name: Great Weather Storm
skillCards.additional:
[Humidity] - Inflict [Cold] Each Attack
[Cold] - Inflicts [Hypothermia] at 6 Stacks
[Hypothermia] - Inflicts 15 Ice DMG each turn for 3 turns
[Rain] - Lowers visibility(accuracy) by 15%
[Damp] - Weakens Fire and Earth-Type attack DMG to 0.5x

skillCards.name: Wind Barrage
skillCards.desc:
Deals 175% Air-Based Damage to all enemies
Inflict [Pierce]
IF only one enemy: Draw Focus Shot
-2 [Air Current]
skillCards.additional:
[Pierce] - Causes 2 Bleed every Turn for 5 turns. Does Not Stack
[Bleed] - Inflicted Loses 5% HP every Turn for each stack, at the end of turn -1 Bleed

skillCards.name: Focus Shot
skillCards.additional:
[Severe Wound] - Inflicts 2 Weakness and 2 Vulnerability each turn for 2 turns
[Weakness] - -15% DMG per Stack
[Vulnerability] - -15% Defense per Stack
[Agony] - -[(Strength + Dexterity) /2] HP per Turn

skillCards.name: Critical Burst
skillCards.desc:
Deal 250% Air-Based Damage to a selected Target
+25% for every bad effect the enemy has

skillCards.name: Sound Boom
skillCards.desc:
Generate a deafening Sound
Inflict [Deafness], [Stun], and [Confusion] to all enemies
-2 [Air Current]
skillCards.additional:
[Deafness] - -2 Buffs to enemies
[Stun] - Cannot Move That Turn
[Confusion] - -15% Accuracy for 3 turns

skillCards.name: Spatial Collapse
skillCards.desc:
Limitations: Can only be used when there is exactly 1 enemy on the field. Deals 25 DMG to self, Initiates [Vacuum] For 3 [Sets], Inflicts Injured to 1 random body parts.

Deal 1350% Air-Based Damage to Enemy
skillCards.additional:
[Vacuum] - -10% Damage to all Air-Based Attacks
[Sets] - Areas/Encounters/Camps/Locations

skillCards.name: Diety of The Wandering Skies
skillCards.desc:
Gain [Advance] every 2 turns
All Air-Based Attack Cards and DMG is based on [(Dex + Str + Int) / 2]
skillCards.additional: [Advance] - Temporarily Increase Dexterity by 5 per stack until end of combat

skillCards.name: All Are Beneath Me
skillCards.desc:
Requires 5 [Advance] minimum to activate.
Consume all [Advance] available.
Deal 300% Air-Based DMG per [Advance] Consumed.
Gain [Exhausted].
skillCards.additional: [Exhausted] - No [Advance] Can be Gained for 15 Turns
